title: Philadelphia: Turkish Mosaic Lamp Workshop
includes: Participants receive a kit with a glass globe, lamp parts, mosaic glass, beads, a template, an LED bulb, glue, and gloves—everything needed to craft their own mosaic lamp safely and easily.
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Create your own Turkish mosaic lamp in this fun, hands-on workshop! All materials are provided, and no experience is needed. Enjoy crafting with vibrant tiles, guided by expert instruction, and sip on complimentary Turkish coffee. Leave with a beautiful, handmade lamp to light up your home!
